integrity: Proof uses an exhaustive automorphism parameterization and finite-field norm kernel; the accompanying finite computations check examples and are not claimed to prove the general result.
scientific_limitations: Applies only when the two-dimensional adjoint action has irreducible quadratic characteristic polynomial over the finite ground field. Does not cover reducible or higher-dimensional modules or automorphism conjugacy classes. Independent validation has not been performed.
title: Fixed-space spectrum of automorphisms of nonsplit three-dimensional almost-abelian Lie algebras
